method: Rendered every page of the three booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (listening 1-16, composing 1-16, elective 1-8) and read every ask page in full; confirmed on contact sheets that listening 1, 7, 12-16, composing 1, 2, 12-16 and elective 1, 3-8 carry no question text (covers, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK, answer lines and staves). Dumped every text-layer span with its font (PyMuPDF) on listening 2-6, 8-11, composing 3-11 and elective 2, and zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 350-500 dpi on: the en dashes in "Bars 1–8" (listening p2 heading and p10 bullet), "bars 1–11" (p5 bullet and Q3(i)/(iii)), "lines 1–2", "lines 3–4?" (p6), "bars 9–16" (p10 bullet and Bars 9–16(i)) and composing Q1 "16–bar" (en dash) against Q3 "16-bar" (hyphen); the hyphens in non-traditional, well-known and Rimsky-Korsakov; the curly apostrophes (U+2019) in Bach’s (x2), Barry’s, conqueror’s and show’d; céilí (x2, precomposed é/í); "3rd" in the Q6 Excerpt 1 heading (printed on the baseline, no superscript); "J.S. Bach.", "W.A. Mozart." and "No.1" (no space); the Q1 Excerpt 3 heading ("... is printed below", no closing stop) and the bare "Excerpt 1/2/3" Q5 A headings (no stop); composing Q3 "Use the form AA¹BA²." (the text layer splits it: "AA", 6pt "1", a 6pt space, "BA", 6pt "2", 12pt "."; the page prints AA¹BA². with no visible word space after ¹, and the full stop after ²); the two Section stems ("Answer ONE QUESTION ONLY in this section: Q1 or Q2 or Q3" / "... Q4 or Q5 or Q6", italic Answer/in this section/or, no closing stop); Q5 "key of G minor" (looks wide on the render, but the text layer has one space: the G glyph is followed by a 1.2pt offset, not a second space); elective "Answer ALL questions.", Q2 "Full details" (the text layer has no space after bold Full; the page prints one) and "4.(a)". Bullets checked on the render: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q6 lead-ins and the Q6 Excerpt 1 / Excerpt 2 headings print bullets (including the restart bullet "The next 8 bars (bars 9–16) will now be played THREE times." and "The excerpt will be played once more. Answer (iv) below."); Q5 A and Q5 B print none; composing bullets as printed, PREPARATORY WORK in regular (not bold) capitals with no bullet; elective Q4(b) four bullets. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets "\n• ", composing/elective bullets " • ", tick boxes "□ ", unbulleted lines joined with a space, "\n" between the two Q1 Excerpt 1(ii), Q2(i) and Q4(iv) stems either side of their answer slots or options, Q5 B grid.stem per the 19 Nov evening ruling) and compared every file string exactly, with no normalisation; then checked all 3,859 word tokens of the file strings, case and punctuation included, against the text layer of the booklet (only AA¹BA². is not a whole text-layer token, confirmed on the render; the 2011-hl-006 OCR reads it "AA'BA'."); then listed the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings (• U+2022, – U+2013, ’ U+2019, é U+00E9, í U+00ED, □ U+25A1, ¹ U+00B9, ² U+00B2). The file has no readFromPage entries. Elective Q2-Q4(b) carry no grid (shared card e-q1-q4 on Q1), so no grid.stem there; Q5 B questionContext is null (its lead-in is in grid.stem). Every address matches the printed numbering: Q1, Q5 A and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt; Q6 Excerpt 1 restarts (i)-(iii) under the printed bars bullet, addressed "Q6 Excerpt 1 Bars 9–16(i)" etc. with U+2013; elective "4.(a)" / "(b)" read as Q4(a) / Q4(b). Every tick-box option list (and the notated option figures of Q4(iv), Q6 Excerpt 1(iii) and Bars 9–16(ii)) is carried in its ask's figure. Observation, not a text difference: Q5 B(i)-(iv) list pages [9] and Q6 Excerpt 2 asks list pages [11], while their grid.stem / questionContext lead-in lines are printed on pages 8 and 10.
